Description.value: Japanese-themed trees and garden plants: sakura (bloom + leaf), keyaki, dogwood (pink + white), plane tree, bamboo, black pine, boxwood, and painted fern. Plantable, harvestable, drop wood. Seeds visibly grow from sapling → mature mesh; bamboo and black pine through a true three-stage chain. Bamboo, boxwood and ferns plant in dense groves. Foliage sways with a custom wind shader. Spawns in pine forest biome, drops in farm loot, stocked at traders. Standalone.
